what.text: This page follows refugees from the Bahamas in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1598 Bahamian refugees, and Canada hosted 88.8% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the Bahamas, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2006 at 12 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
